# BioInspiredInterceptionTask

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A computational task modeled after biological systems' ability to intercept moving targets, implemented via spiking neural dynamics for real-time sensory-motor coordination. Demonstrates a practical, non-generic application of SNNs in iNEST, showing how neuromorphic principles can solve dynamic, time-critical control problems in-network.
